questions.q: "I'll pay." → He ___ to pay.
questions.why: «Я заплачу» — пропозиція, тому *offered to pay*. Після *offer* — *to* + дієслово. *said to pay* — після *say* не вживають *to* + дієслово; *denied* — заперечення; *admitted* — визнання провини.

questions.q: "I didn't take it." → He ___ taking it.
questions.why: «Я не брав» — заперечення провини: *denied taking it*. Після *deny* — *-ing*. *refused* — відмовився щось робити (і з *to*); *promised* і *offered* — з *to*, і зміст інший.

questions.q: "Don't go alone." → She ___ me not to go alone.
questions.why: Застереження — *warn* + особа + *not to*: *She warned me not to go alone.* *suggested me not to* — після *suggest* не вживають особу + *to*; *admitted* — визнав; *apologised* — вибачився.

questions.q: "Sorry I'm late." → She apologised ___ late.
questions.why: *apologise for* + *-ing*: *apologised for being late*. *to be* — після *apologise* потрібне *for* + *-ing*; *that being* — неграматично; *of being* — інший прийменник.

questions.q: "Why don't we go out?" → He suggested ___ out.
questions.why: *suggest* + *-ing*: *He suggested going out.*

questions.q: "You stole the money!" → He accused her ___ stealing it.
questions.why: *accuse somebody of* + *-ing*: *accused her of stealing*. *for* — з *blame* (*blame her for*), а з *accuse* — лише *of*; *from* і *about* не вживають.

questions.q: "Well done!" → They congratulated me ___ winning.
questions.why: *congratulate somebody on* + *-ing*. *for* — розмовна помилка (кальку дає «привітали за»); *with* і *of* після *congratulate* не вживають.

questions.q: Which is incorrect?
questions.why: *suggest* не вживається зі схемою «особа + *to*»: *suggested me to go* — помилка. Правильно *suggested going* / *suggested that we go*. *suggested going*, *suggested that we go*, *suggested we should go* — усі три правильні, тому неправильне лише *suggested me to go*.

questions.q: "I promise to call." → He ___ to call.
questions.why: *promise* + *to*: *He promised to call.* *denied* — заперечив; *insisted to call* — після *insist* потрібне *on* + *-ing*; *accused* — звинуватив, і з *of*.

questions.q: "No, I won't sign it." → He refused ___ it.
questions.why: *refuse* + *to*: *refused to sign it*.

questions.q: "Don't forget your keys." → She reminded me ___ my keys.
questions.why: *remind* + особа + *to*: *reminded me to take my keys*.

questions.q: "Yes, I broke it." → He admitted ___ it.
questions.why: *admit* + *-ing* (або *having* + третя форма).

questions.q: "Thank you for coming." → She thanked us ___ coming.
questions.why: *thank somebody for* + *-ing*: *thanked us for coming*.

questions.q: "You should rest." → The doctor advised me ___.
questions.why: *advise* + особа + *to*: *advised me to rest*.

questions.q: "Let's take a taxi." → She ___ taking a taxi.
questions.why: «Давай візьмемо таксі» — пропозиція: *suggested taking a taxi*. *offered* — запропонував щось зробити сам (і з *to*); *promised* — пообіцяв (з *to*); *agreed* — погодився (з *to*).

questions.q: "I'll help you, I promise." → He ___ to help me.
questions.why: «Я допоможу, обіцяю» — *promised to help*. *suggested to help* — після *suggest* не вживають *to*; *admitted* — визнав; *denied* — заперечив.

questions.q: "You broke the vase!" → She blamed me ___ breaking the vase.
questions.why: *blame somebody for* + *-ing* — звинуватити в чомусь. *of* — з *accuse*, а з *blame* — *for*; *on* — у *blame it on somebody*; *with* не вживають.

questions.q: "Come to my party!" → She ___ me to her party.
questions.why: Запрошення — *invited me to her party*. *suggested me* і *offered me to her party* — неграматично; *apologised* — вибачилася.
*apologise for* + *-ing*.

answer: She advised me to see a doctor
questions.why: *advise* + особа + *to*.
questions.hint: Вона порадила мені звернутися до лікаря.

answer: They agreed to meet at six
questions.why: *agree* + *to*: *agreed to meet*.

questions.q: She begged him ___.
questions.why: *beg* + особа + *to*: *begged him to stay*.

questions.q: He claims ___ the president.
questions.why: *claim* + *to*: *claims to know the president*.

questions.q: They insisted ___ paying for dinner.
questions.why: *insist on* + *-ing*.
